**BLUF:** In Tazewell County, Richlands Police arrested 28-year-old Hunter Brian Gill of Richlands on Oct. 27 for armed robbery and related firearm charges stemming from an Oct. 26 incident at Big Lots; Tazewell County Sheriff Brian Hieatt issued Halloween safety reminders. Mercer County saw large early voter turnout ahead of elections. Regionally, a women’s addiction recovery residence is slated to open in Tazewell County by year’s end, while a southwest/southside Virginia advanced manufacturing tech hub received about $25 million in federal supplemental disaster funding for economic development.[[1]](https://www.wjhl.com/news/crime/suspect-arrested-after-armed-robbery-at-richlands-big-lots/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/tazewell-county-sheriff-shares-halloween-safety-tips/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Richlands, Tazewell County, VA** — On Oct. 26, 2026, at approximately 3:50 p.m., Tazewell County 911 received a report of an armed robbery at Big Lots. Richlands Police responded; the suspect had fled. Investigation determined the suspect approached the register, displayed a firearm, demanded money, and fled on foot. Officers identified and arrested Hunter Brian Gill, 28, of Richlands, on Oct. 27. Charges: armed robbery, use of a firearm in the commission of a felony, and brandishing a firearm. The department thanked the Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office, Commonwealth’s Attorney’s Office, and Tazewell County Narcotics and Violent Crime Task Force for assistance. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wjhl.com/news/crime/suspect-arrested-after-armed-robbery-at-richlands-big-lots/)[[1]](https://www.wjhl.com/news/crime/suspect-arrested-after-armed-robbery-at-richlands-big-lots/)

**Tazewell County, VA** — Tazewell County Sheriff Brian Hieatt shared Halloween safety tips on Oct. 27, noting increases in reckless driving, vandalism, and DUIs on the holiday. He recommended organized events like trunk-or-treat over door-to-door trick-or-treating and advised residents to lock doors, leave lights on, and plan transportation if drinking. [OSINT - NEWS] [source](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/tazewell-county-sheriff-shares-halloween-safety-tips/)[[2]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/27/tazewell-county-sheriff-shares-halloween-safety-tips/)
